paper_title: Evidence for light-by-light scattering and searches for axion-like particles in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} =$ 5.02 TeV
notes: CMS sets new 95% CL exclusion limits on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma vs m_a (5-90 GeV) via gamma gamma -> a -> gamma gamma in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions. The limit is presented in Fig. 7 (g_agamma = 1/Lambda vs m_a plane), which is the correct coupling type (AxionPhoton). However, no numerical table of (m_a, g_agamma) values is provided in the extractable text; the limits exist only as a plot. Cross section limits range 1500-20 nb over 5-90 GeV.
